title: Unguard
description: Dynatrace's insecure cloud-native microservices app, a Twitter clone of about a dozen services in Java, .NET, Go, PHP, Python and Node.js on Kubernetes, with SSRF, command and SQL injection, JWT key confusion, insecure deserialization and over-privileged service accounts.
question: Exploit Unguard's services and reach the Kubernetes cluster behind them.
